mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The mechanism is always active during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates (UNRATE > 10.0) signal a severe economic contraction, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. The threshold captures recessionary conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0.

mechanism_narrative: Joint weakness in housing starts (HOUST) and real sales (RSAFS) below their 1-year moving averages indicates demand contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. The interaction of these two demand indicators is necessary to trigger the signal.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 1-year moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 (relative to 2017 base) signals robust manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The mechanism is active only during late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: Positive payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) consistently indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The mechanism is always active during labor market expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) triggers central bank tightening expectations, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP (GDPC1) above their 1-year moving averages indicates robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The joint condition is necessary for the signal.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 are above their 1-year moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signal reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, suppressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The mechanism is active only during tightening cycles.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is rising.
